sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
key_points: Platform that lets users route prompts to a single model, compare models side by side, or convene a council of up to seven models.
Integrates 300+ models from major labs via the OpenRouter catalog.
Provides workflows such as One Answer, Compare, and Councils with judges.
